non_obvious_findings.finding: The highest-risk ambiguity is not visual design but identity: project-facultad is unbound while pages/study-library is recently published and branch-parity. The system must resolve that mismatch explicitly instead of letting recency silently become authority.

Boot decoupling and regression harness work can proceed in parallel immediately after exact target resolution; forcing them to wait for Page Thread Bridge or Local Steward would create an artificial global bottleneck.

At plan time Truth, Reuse and UX have durable RETURNs, while Intent, Risk and Discover still expose hours-old STARTED heartbeats and no RETURN. Local integration is therefore blocked by missing evidence, not by lack of a campaign shape; live stale-recovery should clear those lanes rather than asking the human to relaunch them manually.
The current V18 URL preserves course_id but resets year/tab/anchor state. A durable same-surface correction contract must carry semantic location, not merely URL or raw scroll.
